en: Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a young woman in an elaborate white lace blouse with a high Victorian/Edwardian collar and a large, styled coiffure. She is framed by an oval or circular arch decorated with flowers and foliage and stands behind a basket overflowing with flowers. The image has soft studio lighting and a romantic, staged composition, typical of early 20th‑century portrait or greeting postcards. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image side.
